caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, beige background. The object depicted is a pitchfork with a long, cylindrical wooden handle that is colored light brown with visible wood grain texture. At the top, there is a horizontal wooden bar attached, from which four evenly spaced, slightly curved metal prongs extend upwards. The prongs are dark in color, contrasting with the lighter wood of the handle and crosspiece. The drawing is detailed with shading to indicate the roundness of the wood and the form of the metal prongs. In the lower right corner, the artist's name "Frances Godfrey" is written in small, neat text. No other objects or details are present in the image.
title: Horse Drawn Hay Fork
